title: Green Shutters and Lemons  (其中一罐是盐)

scenes.title: An Indoor Paint Shop (室内的刷漆工坊)
scenes.summary: On rainy Monday morning, M3 sets up cross-breeze airflow in the wide back hallway so F1 and M1 can paint the four shutters indoors.

scenes.title: Green Glasses (绿色的眼镜)
scenes.summary: M2 insists on painting one shutter slat to help, immediately getting a streak of green paint on the reading glasses perched on his forehead.

scenes.title: Middle D Sings Again (中央D键再次唱响)
scenes.summary: On Tuesday morning, M1 reseats the tiny brass pin and tunes the middle strings while F3 tests middle D on the walnut piano.

scenes.title: Hanging the Green Shutters (挂上绿色百叶窗)
scenes.summary: In Tuesday's bright afternoon sun, M1, M3, and F1 hang the freshly painted green shutters around Room 9's arched glass.

scenes.title: The Welcome Sign (迎宾招牌)
scenes.summary: At the front desk, F1 designs a simple welcome sign and café menu card that M2 and F3 check line by line.

scenes.title: Watch the Low Stool (当心小板凳)
scenes.summary: In the Tuesday evening kitchen, F2 reaches for the big copper teapot on the high shelf and twists her right ankle stepping off the low wooden stool.

scenes.title: Ice, Pillows, and Orders (冰块、枕头和命令)
scenes.summary: F1 and M4 prop F2's ankle comfortably on two pillows while F2 writes out step-by-step Wednesday baking jobs for the whole crew.

scenes.title: One Jar Is Salt (其中一罐是盐)
scenes.summary: Late Tuesday night while tidying the counter for dawn baking, M2 refills two unlabeled white ceramic jars—leaving F1 and M1 unsure which is sugar and which is salt.
